summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Expanded the US-listed universe for the hospitality and travel operating-stack node. The cleanest reference platform is Toast for restaurants. The underfollowed discovery lane contains Agilysys for hotel/resort/casino/cruise property-management and POS software, PAR Technology for enterprise restaurant operating clouds, and Lightspeed Commerce for POS/payments across hospitality and retail. The common chokepoint thesis is operational switching friction: once POS, payments, reservations, inventory, loyalty, menu, labor, and analytics workflows are embedded, operators may defer migrations during labor shortages or peak demand periods. This is research-only universe expansion, not a recommendation. Expanded the US-listed universe around scarce or sticky operating-stack suppliers for hotels, restaurants and travel distribution. The strongest underfollowed lane candidates are not consumer-facing travel brands; they sit in property-management/POS/procurement software, restaurant POS-loyalty-payments, integrated hospitality payments, and GDS/travel-marketplace infrastructure. This is research support only, not a buy/sell recommendation. Expanded the US-listed universe around the hospitality and travel operating stack with an underfollowed discovery lens. The most relevant small/mid-cap candidates cluster around hotel property-management/POS/procurement software, restaurant operating software, hospitality payments, and foodservice distribution/procurement.
